output: pdf_document
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%d %B %Y, %H:%M')`"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

if (!exists("project_folder")) {
  project_folder <- getwd()
  pipeline_folder <- getwd()
  features_file <- "config/features.yaml"
  sample_file <- "config/samples.tsv"
}

source(file.path(pipeline_folder, "workflow", "scripts", "R", "report_helpers.R"))

samples <- readr::read_tsv(file.path(project_folder, sample_file), show_col_types = FALSE)
sample_ids <- unique(samples$sample_id)
```

## Overview

This report covers the **decontaminate** module: removal of tRNA and PhiX
(sequencing-control) contamination from the concatenated reads, via Bowtie mapping.

## tRNA mapping rates

```{r trna-flagstat}
trna <- collect_flagstats(project_folder, "results/decontaminate/trna/%s_tRNA.flagstat", sample_ids)
preview_table(trna, n = nrow(trna), caption = "tRNA mapping rate per sample")
```

## PhiX mapping rates

```{r phix-flagstat}
phix <- collect_flagstats(project_folder, "results/decontaminate/phix/%s_PhiX.flagstat", sample_ids)
preview_table(phix, n = nrow(phix), caption = "PhiX mapping rate per sample")
```

```{r contamination-plot, fig.width=7, fig.height=3.5}
combined <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  dplyr::mutate(trna, reference = "tRNA"),
  dplyr::mutate(phix, reference = "PhiX")
)
if (nrow(combined) > 0) {
  ggplot2::ggplot(combined, ggplot2::aes(x = sample_id, y = mapped_pct, fill = reference)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    ggplot2::labs(title = "Contamination mapping rate per sample", x = NULL, y = "Mapped reads (%)") +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
}
```

## Runtime and resource usage

```{r runtime}
bench <- discover_benchmarks(project_folder, "decontaminate")
runtime_table(bench, caption = "decontaminate module: runtime and peak memory per rule")
resource_allocation_table(bench, "decontaminate", project_folder,
                           caption = "decontaminate module: allocated vs. actual resource usage")
```

```{r runtime-plot, fig.width=7, fig.height=3}
runtime_plot(bench, title = "decontaminate module: total runtime per rule")
```
